definitions.explanation: A research study conducted with human participants to evaluate the safety and efficacy of new drugs or medical treatments before they are approved for general use.

examples.japanese: {新薬|しんやく}の{治験|ちけん}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: A clinical trial for the new drug has begun.

examples.japanese: {治験|ちけん}に{参加|さんか}する{患者|かんじゃ}を{募集|ぼしゅう}している。
examples.english: They are recruiting patients to participate in the clinical trial.

examples.japanese: {治験|ちけん}の{結果|けっか}が{良好|りょうこう}であれば、{来年|らいねん}には{承認|しょうにん}される{見通|みとお}しだ。
examples.english: If the clinical trial results are favorable, the drug is expected to be approved next year.

notes:
USAGE:
Short for {治療|ちりょう}{試験|しけん} (treatment test). Commonly seen in news about pharmaceutical development. Became widely known during the COVID-19 pandemic in discussions about vaccine development.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {治験|ちけん}を{行|おこな}う (to conduct a clinical trial)
- {治験|ちけん}に{参加|さんか}する (to participate in a clinical trial)
- {治験|ちけん}{結果|けっか} (clinical trial results)
- {治験|ちけん}{薬|やく} (investigational drug)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {臨床試験|りんしょうしけん}: clinical trial — a more formal synonym
- {知見|ちけん}: knowledge, insight — a homophone with different kanji and meaning
